title: The signInStrategy config surface fixes the shape not the choice
asA: operator configuring which sign-in strategies the project's Clerk instance offers
iWant: a single config record on the project side that names the primary and alternate strategies
soThat: changing the enabled strategy set is a config edit and a Clerk-dashboard change rather than a codebase search-and-replace

acceptanceCriteria.description: The project exposes a single `signInStrategy` config record whose shape is `{ primary: string, alternates: string[] }` and whose values are Clerk's currently-documented strategy identifiers.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the project's configuration surface at boot
acceptanceCriteria.when: the sign-in surface reads its strategy configuration
acceptanceCriteria.then: the surface reads exactly one `signInStrategy` config record; the record's own-property keys are exactly `{primary, alternates}`; `primary` is a non-empty string; `alternates` is an array of strings

acceptanceCriteria.description: A source-tree scan finds no hard-coded strategy string outside the config module.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the project's source tree after the blueprint's TACs are realised
acceptanceCriteria.when: a scan enumerates literal string matches for the strategy identifiers known to Clerk's strategy enumeration at build time
acceptanceCriteria.then: every match resolves to the single config module or to test fixtures; no sign-in surface, no middleware, no handler carries a hard-coded strategy string
